title: C2 墨绘青石
mode: new complete style illustration with two actual project images as style references only
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete low-tier cultivation-game formation plate, a NEW illustration in the actual hand-painted style of this specific project. Both supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Reference image 1 (the existing broad sword item icon): copy its confident dark ink contour, broad simplified grey value shapes, dry painted tonal marks, ivory edge accents and clear small-size item silhouette. Reference image 2 (the existing Chinese-game service-hall screen): copy its quiet low-saturation blue-grey stone, warm ivory, grey-brown minor accents, tidy restrained ink work and understated hand-painted material family. Do NOT copy the sword shape, building, UI, text or layout of either reference.

Primary subject: a plain functional hand-held formation plate made from LIGHT grey-celadon stone, clipped-corner short square / near octagon with a broad usable face and a thin modest rim. STRICT exact 90-degree top-down orthographic view, no perspective, no angled view. Entire object visible, centered with clear outer margin. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the item; there is NO black backdrop, room, table, floor, paper sheet or interface.

MOST IMPORTANT VISUAL STYLE: distinctly drawn 2D game item like the reference sword, charcoal ink outlines, lightly irregular brush contour, broad hand-painted color masses and simple ink-grey shadow planes, narrow ivory-white light edges. Low-saturation pale grey-celadon face, dark grey-green contour and a little dull ochre-grey inlay. Small, simple contact shadows only, expressed as painted shapes, not lighting simulation. No realistic stone microtexture, photorealistic surface, polished gemstone, 3D render, raised sculptural relief, museum-object photograph, metallic reflectance, cinematic lighting or glossy magical glow. Prefer readable silhouettes and brush simplification over fine detail. The low-tier object should look at home beside the reference sword and the reference UI, not luxurious or high-level.

Exactly FOUR SMALL distinct installed components, each crisp and separate with substantial quiet empty plate face between them; use these simple footprints on a HIDDEN four-by-four arrangement, without drawing the grid: upper-left a 1x1 SHORT PIN / BONE-JADE sensor socket, compact ivory-grey stub set in one angular grey-green seat; center-left a 1x1 SQUARE STONE SEAL formation eye, flat square grey-green stamp with one restrained abstract incised seal-stroke, not a readable character; lower-left a 2x1 HORIZONTAL shallow spirit-marrow trough, long thin stone cradle with a soft grey-celadon and ivory mineral interior; right-middle a 1x2 VERTICAL ward executor made from TWO small curved jade slivers one above the other on a slender shared stone mounting, entirely functional small component, NOT a shield or large crescent ornament. All components are low-profile hand-drawn shapes, like separate inventory item parts mounted on the plate. No enormous central jewel, gold medallion, stars, flowers, butterflies or decorative jewelry.

Routes: only TWO clearly separate routes with distinct small physical contact ends. The upper route is a fine MUTED CINNABAR INK signal trace: from the upper-left sensor's east contact, run across the upper part and bend into the upper contact of the right-side ward. Lower route is a narrow grey-celadon / pale dull ochre-gold inlaid ENERGY vein: from the lower-left marrow trough's east contact, run along the lower part, then bend upward to the ward's lower contact. The two routes DO NOT CROSS, do not touch other components and do not merge; formation eye may remain unwired. Lines are painted/inlaid into the stone surface, modest thin width with quiet graceful bent corners, never ropes, neon tubes, broad colored plastic bars, modern PCB conductors, microchip leads or decorative sprawling constellations.

Finish: a few faint pale-ink carving strokes ONLY on the rim to convey a cultivation formation artifact. No obvious checkerboard, no grid lines, no labels, UI, text, flags, extra objects or baked-in background. Restrained Chinese ink-and-mineral-color game illustration, confident simplified brushwork matching the actual supplied project references.
